recommendations.title: Rewrite homepage/service page title tag & meta description for Bronx property management queries
recommendations.what: Rewrite the title tag and meta description on the page ranking for 'bronx property management companies' and variants. Lead with 'Flat-Fee Bronx Property Management' and a concrete differentiator (24/7 emergency response for no-heat, leaks, boiler failures) instead of generic phrasing. Target the exact-match phrases 'property management companies bronx' and 'bronx property management'.
recommendations.why: Four Bronx-intent queries rank 3.3–4.0 with 95+88+78+73+45=379 impressions and only 1 total click (combined CTR ~0.26%). At positions 3–4, expected CTR is 6–10%; the listing is being seen and skipped.
recommendations.expectedResult: Lift combined CTR on these 5 queries from ~0.26% to 4–6%, adding ~15–20 clicks/28 days.
recommendations.metric: clicks from Bronx property management queries in Search Console

recommendations.title: Fix title/meta on pages ranking #1 for 'property management company' and 'apartment management company'
recommendations.what: Identify the two pages ranking position 1.0 for 'property management company' (55 impr) and 'apartment management company' (48 impr) and rewrite their title tags to actually match the query intent. A #1 ranking with 0 clicks almost always means the title doesn't contain the query or looks off-topic in the SERP.
recommendations.why: Two queries at position 1.0 with 55 and 48 impressions returned 0 clicks — zero CTR at #1 is nearly impossible unless the title/snippet is mismatched to the query.
recommendations.expectedResult: Should recover 10–25% CTR on both queries, ~10–25 clicks/28 days.

recommendations.title: Add internal links from popular posts to the 6 orphaned posts
recommendations.what: From 5–10 well-linked existing posts in the same seasonal/topical cluster (fall winterization, pipes, basements), add contextual body links to the 6 orphaned posts, including 'Why Your Bronx Rental's Pipes Freeze Before January'. Nave only links outward from new posts, so this fills the backlink gap for older content.
recommendations.why: 6 of 105 posts have zero internal inbound links from other post bodies. With only 179 GA4 sessions/30 days and 26.14% avg scroll depth, orphaned posts get essentially no discovery.
recommendations.expectedResult: Orphaned posts begin receiving impressions in Search Console within 4–6 weeks; small lift in total site sessions.
recommendations.metric: impressions on the 6 previously orphaned URLs

recommendations.title: Expand the pipe-freeze post with a 24/7 emergency response angle targeting 'bronx property management'
recommendations.what: Expand this post with a section on 'what to do at 2am when a pipe bursts in a Bronx rental' — vendor call tree, typical response windows, cost of emergency plumber vs. flat-fee managed response. Add internal links to and from the service page so it reinforces rankings for 'bronx property management' (position 12.0, striking distance).
recommendations.why: 'bronx property management' sits at position 12.0 with 73 impressions and 0 clicks — striking distance for page one. Pairing a high-intent service query with a practical emergency-response post builds topical depth without duplicating existing titles.
recommendations.expectedResult: Move 'bronx property management' from position 12 to 8–10; first clicks on the query.
